namespace = omni_sb_ai

omni_sb_ai.1 = {
	type = character_event
	hidden = yes

	immediate = {
		# Every pass spends at least one point, so the loop always ends.
		while = {
			limit = { omni_sb_can_buy_any = yes }
			if = { limit = { omni_sb_can_buy_in_omnic = yes } omni_sb_ai_pick_omnic = yes }
			else = { omni_sb_ai_pick_any = yes }
		}
	}
}
